set.body:
Make the compiled solver the production strategy across the canonical motion pipeline.

Acceptance criteria:
AC-423-01: Pair estimation uses accepted and rejected SE(3) steps with explicit LM or GN damping and monotone accepted objective updates.
AC-423-02: Deterministic capture seeds improve or preserve the registered capture-range success rate without changing truth or dropping overlap.
AC-423-03: Multiscale levels use filtered GridTower images, physically meaningful controls, and endpoint-preserving pose continuation.
AC-423-04: Series estimation supports declared reference anchoring and temporal warm starts; template refresh computes exactly the named statistic from valid aligned frames.
AC-423-05: The coordinate-search implementation remains accessible only through an explicitly named reference or fallback policy and is not the default production engine.
AC-423-06: Existing motion application, acquisition timing, trajectory, template, and series APIs require no competing pose, sampler, or interpolation authority.
AC-423-07: Focused JVM and Scala.js suites pass before mig-414 runs the complete acceptance court.
set.title: Integrate robust SE(3) LM/GN across pair, multiscale, series, and template estimation
